name: Infrathon: a 24-hour benchmark where agents optimize real AI infrastructure; 135 of 150 runs were still improving late
title: Infrathon: a 24-hour benchmark where agents optimize real AI infrastructure; 135 of 150 runs were still improving late
summary: Allen AI, UW and Stanford release a benchmark of 25 real AI-infra tasks run on H100s with six agent configurations over 24 hours; rankings shift with the time horizon, and Claude Opus 5.5 found a KV-cache codec scoring 19.86 against 6.82 for a human-designed one.
